title: machaeranthera canescens var. shastensis
intro: Machaeranthera canescens var. shastensis, commonly known as Shasta greasewood, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Machaeranthera canescens var. shastensis include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
